blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — An independent, church-led fact-finding panel on Wednesday slammed United States President Donald Trump’s call for members of the International Criminal Court (ICC) to step down, warning that political assaults against the Hague-based tribunal will “gravely jeopardize” the quest for justice for thousands slain in the Duterte administration’s bloody war against drugs. In a statement, the Philippine Truth and Reconciliation Commission (Truth Commission) on the country’s “drug war” killings rejected Trump’s remarks, characterizing his push to compel ICC members to resign as “self-serving, irresponsible, and leaves many of those who suffered injustice around the world more vulnerable […]...
